message: On 07/20/2005 at 1505 my wife and I were receiving a call from our son who is incarcerated at Indiana State Prison, Michigan City, IN. T-Netix broke the connection with a recording saying that custom calling features were not permitted. No custom calling was in use. My wife was on one phone and I was on another phone on the same phone line. Our son called back but that cost us another "connection fee".
